title: TransformationReceipt/v1
description: A receipt proving one scientific object was derived from another by a named transformation, carrying the honest cost of the step. The receipt is the unit of lineage: it binds a source_object_id to a target_object_id, names the transform_kind and the conversion_class (LOSSLESS / LOSSY_EXPLICIT / LOSSY_IMPLICIT_DETECTED), lists the assumptions it introduced and the features it dropped, and (for a backend projection) binds the adapter profile and pack hash. CRITICAL INVARIANT (schema + python): conversion_class=LOSSLESS REQUIRES introduced_assumptions=[] AND dropped_features=[]; a lossy transformation that claims LOSSLESS is a dishonest upgrade and is rejected. LOSSY_IMPLICIT_DETECTED may ONLY be produced by a detector (a lineage auditor comparing two trees), never claimed by a producer — the producer API (record_transformation) does not expose it. The receipt carries the two safety consts (canonical_writes=0, grants_authority=false). Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

allOf.$comment: LOSSLESS => no introduced assumptions and no dropped features. A lossy step (one that introduces an assumption or drops a feature) must declare itself LOSSY_EXPLICIT; it cannot claim LOSSLESS. LOSSY_IMPLICIT_DETECTED is detector-only (enforced by constructor separation in python), so no producer allOf rule produces it.

receipt_id.description: Content-addressed identity: sha256 over the canonical encoding of the receipt (without this field), prefixed 'sha256:'. Computed by srl.semantic.transforms.receipt_id.

source_object_id.description: The object_id of the input object (the source of the transformation step). For a projection, this is the input MathIR/v1 ir_id; for a lineage chain, a downstream receipt's source_object_id MUST equal the upstream receipt's target_object_id.

target_object_id.description: The object_id of the output object (the target of the transformation step). For a projection, this is the projected (restricted) MathIR/v1 ir_id.

conversion_class.description: The honest cost classification of the step. LOSSLESS: no information is lost (the target is a faithful re-expression of the source; introduced_assumptions and dropped_features must be empty). LOSSY_EXPLICIT: the producer declares a loss (an introduced assumption or a dropped feature). LOSSY_IMPLICIT_DETECTED: a detector comparing two trees found a loss the producer did not declare; producers may NEVER set this value (enforced by constructor separation in srl.semantic.transforms), only the detector constructor may.

introduced_assumptions.description: Assumptions the transformation step introduced (each a named assumption with a justification). Empty for a LOSSLESS step. An introduced assumption travels with the object FOREVER via the lineage chain (the honesty rules: a lossy step never upgrades evidence).

assumption.description: A concise statement of the assumption introduced (e.g. 'calculus1.diff is approximated by finite differences').

justification.description: Why the assumption is acceptable for this step (e.g. 'the solver backend lacks symbolic differentiation').

dropped_features.description: Features (operators / sub-expressions) the step dropped or replaced with an approximation, each a '<cd>.<name>' pair. Empty for a LOSSLESS step. A dropped feature is the mechanism by which a lossy projection downgrades the evidence carried by an object.

adapter_profile_ref.description: For a backend projection (transform_kind=project), the profile_id of the AdapterSemanticProfile/v1 governing the projection, or null for a transformation not bound to a backend adapter. A projection receipt MUST carry a non-null adapter_profile_ref (validated at the Python layer by project_to_backend).

pack_hash.description: For a backend projection, the sha256 content hash of the adapter pack bytes (the ArtifactRef digest the profile's pack_ref points at), or null for a transformation not bound to a backend adapter. A projection receipt MUST carry a non-null pack_hash (validated at the Python layer by project_to_backend).

created_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at seconds precision (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). No offset, no fractional seconds.

canonical_writes.description: Safety const: a receipt is immutable once authored. Always 0; a non-zero value is a contract violation.

grants_authority.description: Safety const: a receipt never grants authority on its own. Always false; a true value is a contract violation. A LOSSLESS receipt is still an admission of well-formed lineage, not an authorization to act on the target.
